comment: The pitch was in excellent condition and the floodlights made our night match feel like a league game. Booking was straightforward.
Changing rooms were clean and the staff helped us start on time. The best football field we have used in Nasr City.
Great surface and easy parking, though the cafe was busy after 8. We will take the 6pm slot next time.
Indoor court, a proper scoreboard, and air conditioning that actually works. Perfect for our weekly basketball run.
Well maintained hardwood and simple parking in New Cairo. A slightly longer warm-up window between bookings would help.
The clay was freshly prepared and the lighting stays even after sunset. Rackets were ready when we arrived.
Quiet location in Maadi and a fair hourly rate. Seating for friends could be a little more comfortable.
Booked a morning session and the court was ready exactly on time. The smoothest tennis booking I have had.
Premium padel courts with a useful pro shop. The turf plays fast and true, even in a long rally.
Sky Arena is worth the drive to Sheikh Zayed. The coaching desk helped us book a lesson after the match.
